definition: Terminate at the modeled filled SELL event in E before any later local decision or reentry. Original21 ON fills are OPEN_MARKET; alternative modeled fills must retain the exact unchanged public resolve_fill trigger, filled_at and time_precision, including DAILY_OPEN_PLUS_TICK with SESSION precision when applicable. Do not force an alternative to OPEN_MARKET because earlier prose abbreviated the E execution event as E-open.
causal_boundary: E high/low may resolve a modeled E order under the original execution contract; they never become an earlier D-known state input. SESSION precision does not establish an observed intraday timestamp.
blocked_sell: Unfilled attempts remain pending under the original rules; no made-up open fill, new epsilon, cash or cutoff liquidation.
alternative_status: Counterfactual model-filled only, not a new actual-funded trade
